note: The game UI's style table (Core/include/ftcore/UiStyle.h). Colours are sRGB hex. Text px are at 1080p before the player's text scale; nothing draws below min_text_px at 1080p or min_text_px_absolute at any height. Import checks contrast on the backing over a white picture that text on its hairline edge reads 4.5:1 over white, and that danger, ally and weak_point each have their own cue shape. The look is this table plus the stroke painters (Core UiStroke). Each world has its own ink and accent. The unwritten ink is a cold grey and its ink_dim is scaled from it as the other worlds' are (luminance x 0.6975); its accent is the ink itself (the prompt glyph's ring), and its backing and ally are cold neutrals. A value line's fill is the world's own fill token (2026-11-16: Solhaven parchment, Lattice cyan, Unwritten grey; white in high contrast), its track the world's backing at 0.45 with the track token as a 1 px top hairline, and its end a square ink cap lines.cap_grow px wider than the line (none on the dotted guard: lines.guard_dot dots at lines.guard_pitch). One danger red (E60012) in every world: red means harm to the player (the hit cue, the lost hp, the low underline, the call triangle) and nothing else; each colour-vision palette moves danger to luminance about 0.18 at its own hue. The weak point is Mark (pale gold) in every world. The red fails the text rule, so danger_underline (on in every world) draws a danger word in ink with the red as its underline, and import measures danger 3:1 against the track body's colour and the ink instead (against the world fills it is under 3:1 in the lattice and the unwritten, reported, not enforced); marks_accent2 (off everywhere) would put accent2 on marks. A world that leaves either key out has it off. sig_pulse, sig_arcs and sig_margin_rule switch the three signature devices (the Release pulse, ring arcs, the margin rule; margin_rule holds the rule's sizes): off in every world until the owner picks, and a pick flips one row. The other lattice and unwritten values are provisional until those worlds' UI passes.
